integrity: The proof is symbolic. The key source inputs are Zariski density of the chosen set, exclusion of the origin, the definition of the finite-support ideal, and the source's proof that the witness ideal consists of zero-divisors with zero annihilator. No computational experiment is used as a substitute for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the distinguished three-generated witness ideal at the missing origin in the Tran--Nguyen construction. It does not classify the filtrations of other maximal ideals and does not assert that the ambient ring is Noetherian or adically separated.
title: The non-McCoy witness has a regular local model and a nonseparated power filtration
